description_multiloc.en:
In 2025 we've decided to do a renovation of the Coffman Park in order to build a more enjoyable recreation area for residents. Please explore the plan in the following survey and respond to questions about the proposal.

Thank you!
Help us understand who is participating in this survey so we can design a park that meets the needs of all community members.

title_multiloc.en: Accessibility for all ages and abilities
I prefer fewer features in the park if it means lower maintenance costs. We should preserve existing trees, even if it limits new development.
The park should prioritize quiet natural areas, even if it limits space for sports or events.
It’s more important to add security features than to keep an open and natural look.
The park should host community events, even if it means more noise on weekends.
I would accept fewer trees if it meant better lighting and safer paths.
I'd rather have more native plants than large lawn areas for playing.
I'd prefer a fenced playground for safety, even if it feels less open.
I support water features (like fountains) even if they require more maintenance.
The park should offer Wi-Fi access, even if it means installing tech equipment in nature.
